title: 第355章 无尽海域寻踪第354章 无尽海域
content_zh:
深蓝海域暗流奔涌，氤氲的水系灵气混杂着浓郁煞气漫天飘荡。
追梦隐匿周身金仙威压，身形如一缕无形清风，穿梭在十万丈深海之中。
一路深入龟龙海域腹地，他终于亲眼窥见了无尽海域独有的双轨修炼体系，与起源10大大陆人类修士百花齐放的修行之路截然不同，自成一方浩瀚道统。
这片海域的海族生灵，生来便拥有得天独厚的体魄根基，修行之路截然分化两派，泾渭分明，传承亿万年未曾更改。
其一便是正统海族修真体系，遵循炼气、筑基、金丹、元婴、化神、返虚、合体、大乘、半步飞升的修士境界阶梯，恪守天地修行至理。
海族修士一旦突破元婴期，便能化作人形。
大道万千，人为万灵之长、天地道体本源，唯有化为人形，方能最直观地感悟天地规则、参悟各种大道至理，大幅提升法则领悟度，突破境界桎梏。
也正因如此，无尽海域的高阶海族修士，五成以上皆为人形姿态。
无数化形海族聚集一方，依托海底灵脉、天然秘境，修筑起一座座恢弘壮阔的海底城池，街巷纵横、殿宇林立，灵灯长明不熄。
城内商铺云集、集市繁盛，海族修士往来络绎不绝，交易灵材、法宝、功法丹药，烟火气与修行道韵交织，俨然一副完整的修行文明景象，丝毫不输中央大陆的顶级仙城。
而另一派，则是极致的肉身苦修之道。
这一派海族修士数量更为庞大，理念极端且偏执。
他们坚信海族天生霸体得天独厚，鳞甲坚逾神兵、肉身力撼山海，远比历经天劫洗礼、化形的修真之路更加强大、更加纯粹。
在他们眼中，化形便是舍弃自身种族天赋、自废强横肉身根基，是最愚蠢的修行方式。
除却理念追随者，还有大批底层海族受限于自身血脉天赋，修为终生无法触及元婴化形门槛，穷尽一生只能打磨肉身、淬炼筋骨。
这些肉身派海族不修灵力、不悟法则，终日以深海重压、潮汐之力、凶兽搏杀淬炼己身，肉身强度层层叠加，同级之下，肉身爆发力远超内陆同阶修炼者，凶悍无比。
在人类修士的视角中，这两派海族有着清晰的划分界限：化形修法的海族，皆为妖修，丹田凝有精纯内丹，周身鳞甲、精血、骨羽皆是炼器制符的顶级材料；固守本体、苦修肉身的海族，便是实打实的海中妖兽，全身尽是瑰宝，妖丹可炼丹、筋骨可炼器、皮毛可制甲，最珍贵的妖兽肉身蕴含海量天地精华，长期服食可洗髓伐脉、精进修为、锤炼体魄，是人类修炼者千金难求的无上补品。
追梦一路前行，目光淡漠扫过沿途厮杀的海族、繁华的海底集市、错落的海族城池，心中已然对这片海域的整体战力有了精准的评判。
起源界十大大陆，素来以中央大陆灵气最盛、资源最优、道统最完善，可与这无尽海域相比，依旧有着天壤之别。
内陆百年难出一尊化神大能，便是一方顶级巨擘，可在这片外海疆域，化神海族随处可见，返虚、合体强者镇守海域核心，元婴修士更是遍地游走，平均修行底蕴、修士基数、整体战力，全方位碾压十大超级大陆。

追梦眸色渐沉，心底已然敲定杀伐决断。
无尽海域海族族群庞大、战力滔天，如今安分守己盘踞深海，可谁也无法保证未来不会跨界出征、入侵内陆大陆。
届时十大大陆的人类修士根本无力抗衡，终将生灵涂炭、宗门覆灭。
恰逢此次寻亲之机，正好借机清扫海域高阶战力，斩断海族潜在威胁，为日后邹家众人飞升铺路。
至于肆意屠戮海族带来的无边因果业力，追梦早已全然不惧。
如今他巅峰记忆尽数解封，手握万千解厄秘术，再多的业力根本无法缠身，更无法动摇他的无上道心，杀尽宵小，亦是替天行道、安定万域，心中无半分阻滞，杀伐之心愈发坚定。
循着二女精血玉晶的微弱牵引，追梦横穿整片龟龙海域，踏入毗邻的蛇龙海域疆域。
此处风浪更凶、煞气更浓，深海之下盘踞着无数蛇鳞海族，毒性灵力弥漫四方，海域暗沉阴冷，杀机四伏。
为打探确切踪迹，追梦身形微显，拦下一队巡游的化神初期蛇鳞妖修。
面对金仙威压的骤然笼罩，这队海族瞬间四肢僵硬、灵力凝滞，连反抗的资格都没有。
追梦神魂一扫，强行读取其毕生记忆，终于探查到了小玉与小兰的过往踪迹，眼底瞬间涌上滔天戾气。
三年前，小玉与小兰误入蛇龙海域边境。
蛇龙海域掌控者——蛇龙皇子座下一尊化神后期蛇鳞妖修，偶然窥见二女绝美容颜，顿时心生贪念，欲将二人生擒活捉，献给荒淫霸道的蛇龙皇子充当玩物侍妾。
那尊妖修一路追杀，术法毒雾铺天盖地，手段阴狠歹毒，二女一路狼狈逃窜、拼死抵抗，数次濒临绝境，最终靠着小玉融合的三元灵根秘术、小兰坚韧的身法遁术，拼死撕裂海域屏障，逃离蛇龙海域，不知遁向了内海何方。
得知真相的瞬间，追梦周身仙光骤然暴戾，周遭万里深海瞬间冻结。
一缕森冷至极的杀意席卷整片海域，金仙二层巅峰的无上威压轰然炸开，深海万千海族瞬间匍匐震颤，瑟瑟发抖，连呼吸都为之停滞。
“区区海域妖邪，也敢欺我之人，辱我至亲。”
追梦声线冰冷，不带一丝温度，响彻万丈深海。
他心中怒火炽盛，今日不仅要寻回小玉、小兰，更要血洗无尽海域外海内海所有化神后期及以上的海族强者，尽数斩除海域高端战力，永绝后患。

content_en:
Undercurrents surged in the deep blue sea, and the dense water aura mixed with the rich evil spirit floated all over the sky.
Zhui Meng hides the pressure of the Golden Immortal around him, and his body shape is like an invisible breeze, shuttling through the deep sea.
Traveling deep into the hinterland of the Turtle Dragon Sea, he finally saw with his own eyes the dual-track cultivation system unique to the Endless Sea. It was completely different from the cultivation paths of human monks from the 10 continents, and formed a vast system of its own.
The sea creatures in this sea area are born with a unique physical foundation, and their cultivation paths are completely divided into two groups, with clear distinctions and inheritance that has not changed for hundreds of millions of years.
One is the orthodox Hai Clan's cultivation system, which follows the monk's realm ladder of Qi refining, foundation building, golden elixir, Nascent Soul, spirit transformation, return to void, integration, Mahayana, and half-step ascension, and adheres to the principles of heaven and earth cultivation.
Once a sea tribe monk breaks through the Nascent Soul stage, he can transform into a human form.
There are thousands of avenues, and humans are the leader of all spirits and the origin of heaven and earth. Only by transforming into a human form can we most intuitively understand the rules of heaven and earth, understand the principles of various avenues, greatly improve the understanding of laws, and break through the shackles of the realm.
Because of this, more than 50% of the high-level sea monks in the Endless Sea are in humanoid form.
Countless transformed sea tribes gathered together, relying on the spiritual veins and natural secrets of the seabed to build magnificent underwater cities, with streets and lanes, palaces, and spiritual lanterns that were always lit.
The city is crowded with shops and markets are prosperous. Sea monks are constantly coming and going, trading spiritual materials, magic weapons, and martial arts elixirs. The atmosphere of fireworks is intertwined with the rhythm of spiritual practice. It is like a complete sight of spiritual civilization, which is not inferior to the top fairy cities in the Central Continent.
The other sect is the ultimate way of physical asceticism.
This sect of Sea Clan monks has a larger number, and their ideas are extreme and paranoid.
They firmly believe that the Sea Clan is blessed with a naturally hegemonic body. Their scales are stronger than divine weapons, and their physical bodies are powerful enough to shake mountains and seas. They are far more powerful and purer than the path of cultivation that has gone through the baptism of heavenly tribulations and transformation.
In their eyes, transforming means abandoning one's own racial talents and destroying the foundation of the tyrannical body. It is the stupidest way to practice.
In addition to the followers of the idea, there are also a large number of low-level sea people who are limited by their own bloodline talents. Their cultivation cannot reach the threshold of Nascent Soul's transformation throughout their lives. They can only polish their bodies and temper their muscles and bones throughout their lives.
These physical sea tribes do not cultivate spiritual power or understand the laws. They spend all their time tempering their bodies with the pressure of the deep sea, the power of tides, and fighting ferocious beasts. The strength of their physical bodies is superimposed layer by layer. At the same level, the explosive power of their physical bodies far exceeds that of practitioners of the same level inland, and is extremely fierce.
From the perspective of human monks, there is a clear dividing line between the two groups of sea people: the sea people who take form and practice magic are all demon cultivators, and their Dantian contains pure inner elixirs. The scales, blood, and bone feathers all over the body are the top materials for refining weapons and talismans; A solid sea monster is full of treasures. The monster elixir can be used to make elixirs, the muscles and bones can be used to refine weapons, and the fur can be used to make armor. The most precious monster body contains a large amount of essence of heaven and earth. Long-term consumption can cleanse the marrow and cut the pulse, improve cultivation, and temper the body. It is a supreme tonic that human cultivators can hardly find.
As Chai Meng walked forward, his eyes indifferently swept over the fighting sea clans, the bustling underwater market, and the scattered sea clan cities along the way, and he already had an accurate judgment on the overall combat power of this sea area.
Among the ten major continents in the Origin World, the Central Continent has always had the most spiritual energy, the best resources, and the most complete moral system. However, compared with this endless sea area, there is still a huge difference.
It is rare for a hundred years inland to produce a god-transforming power, which is a top giant. However, in this outer sea area, the god-transforming sea tribe can be seen everywhere. The strong ones who have returned to the void and merged bodies guard the core of the sea area. The Nascent Soul monks are traveling everywhere. Their average cultivation background, monk base, and overall combat power can crush the ten super continents in all aspects.
Chai Meng's eyes darkened, and he had already made up his mind to kill.
The Sea Clan in the Endless Sea has a huge population and tremendous fighting power. Now they are content to stay in the deep sea, but no one can guarantee that they will not go on cross-border expeditions in the future., invade the inland continent.
At that time, the human monks from the ten major continents will be unable to compete, and their lives will eventually be destroyed and their sects will be destroyed.
It just so happens that this opportunity to find relatives is a good opportunity to clean up the high-level combat forces in the sea area, cut off potential threats to the Sea Clan, and pave the way for everyone in the Zou family to ascend in the future.
As for the boundless karma brought about by the wanton slaughter of the Hai clan, Zhui Meng is no longer afraid of it.
Now that all of his peak memories have been unsealed, he holds thousands of secret techniques to resolve misfortune. No amount of karma can hold him back, nor can it shake his supreme Taoist heart. Killing all Xiaoxiao is also a way to act for heaven and stabilize the world. There is no hindrance in his heart, and his desire to kill becomes more and more determined.
Following the strong pull of the jade crystals of the essence and blood of the two women, Dream Chaser traveled across the entire Turtle and Dragon Sea and entered the adjacent Snake and Dragon Sea.
The wind and waves here are more fierce and the evil spirit is thicker. There are countless snake-scale sea tribes entrenched under the deep sea. The poisonous spiritual power permeates all directions. The sea area is dark and cold, and murderous intentions are everywhere.
In order to find out the exact trace, Zhui Meng revealed his figure and stopped a group of cruising snake-scale demon cultivators in the early stage of divine transformation.
Faced with the sudden pressure of the Golden Immortal, this group of sea people instantly stiffened their limbs and stagnated their spiritual energy, and they were not even qualified to resist.
Chasing Dream swept away his soul and forcibly read his life-long memory, finally detecting the past traces of Xiaoyu and Xiaolan, and his eyes instantly filled with anger.
Three years ago, Xiaoyu and Xiaolan strayed into the border of the Snake Dragon Sea Area.
The master of the Snake Dragon Sea Territory, a snake-scale demon cultivator in the late stage of divine transformation, under the throne of the Snake Dragon Prince, happened to catch a glimpse of the beautiful faces of the two women. He suddenly became greedy and wanted to capture them alive and offer them to the lewd and domineering Snake Dragon Prince as his playthings and concubines.
The demon cultivator pursued him all the way, using his spells and poisonous fog to cover the sky, and his methods were vicious. The two girls fled in embarrassment, resisted desperately, and were on the verge of despair several times. Finally, relying on Xiaoyu's fusion of the three-yuan spiritual root secret technique and Xiaolan's tenacious body escape technique, they desperately tore through the sea barrier, escaped from the snake dragon sea, and escaped to the inland sea.
The moment he learned the truth, the fairy light around Meng Zhui suddenly became violent, and the deep sea thousands of miles around him instantly froze.
A wisp of extremely cold murderous intent swept across the entire sea area, and the supreme pressure of the Golden Immortal's second-level peak exploded. Thousands of sea tribes in the deep sea instantly crawled and trembled, shivering, and even their breathing was stagnant.
"Even the monsters in the sea dare to bully my people and humiliate my loved ones."
Dream Chasing’s voice was cold, without any warmth, and resounded throughout the deep sea.
The anger in his heart was raging. Today, he not only wanted to find Xiaoyu and Xiaolan, but also wanted to bloodbath all the sea clan strongmen in the late stage of divine transformation and above in the inner and outer seas of the endless sea, kill all the high-end combat power in the sea area, and avoid future troubles forever.
